audience: resource planners and project managers who plan people and track time in Runn

useCases.title: Review planned assignments for a date range
useCases.text: List planned assignments between two dates, with the role and minutes per day. List the people to match each assignment to a name.

useCases.title: Compare planned and logged time
useCases.text: List logged time, split into billable and nonbillable minutes, next to the planned assignments. Read the project phases for their dates and budgets.

useCases.title: Review projects, budgets and clients
useCases.text: List projects with their budget and pricing model. Open one project for its status flags and tags, and list the clients.

useCases.title: Check a person's profile and leave
useCases.text: Read one person's team, tags, skills and custom fields. List the leave records of that person.

useCases.title: Plan an assignment for a person
useCases.text: Assign one person to a project in one role for a date range, with minutes per day. The tool does not check for overlaps, so list the assignments first.

useCases.title: Log hours worked on a project
useCases.text: Log hours one person worked on a project, in one role, on one day. Each call adds more time, so list the logged time first.
